_doc: Owner-approved text corrections applied by tools/build_assets.py after verbatim import. Each entry: {"item": "<hisn item id, e.g. h128_0>", "find": "<exact substring in source>", "replace": "<approved text>", "source": "<where the approved wording comes from>", "approved": "<date / by @midroid5G>"}. The build fails if 'find' is not found exactly once. Empty = pure verbatim dataset.
